name: audit-registry-snapshot-sd-twin
title: SD pack twin: registry snapshot producer parity
description: Mirror the generated registry-snapshot.json producer (schemaVersion 1) added to se-ai-command-pack's generate-skill-surfaces.py in the SD command pack, so SD checkouts ship the same-schema snapshot and skill_review.py can prefer it there too. Precondition for removing the AST fallback fleet-wide (see audit-registry-snapshot-ast-removal). Snapshot schema: schemaVersion, familyOrder, skills[{name,family}], platforms (sorted), sharedReferences.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Cross-repository: the producer change lands in sd-ai-command-pack (github.com/platypeeps/sd-ai-command-pack, sibling checkout ../sd-ai-command-pack), so it needs explicit approval for a PR against another repository -- outside the autonomous run-level authority. Nothing in this repository changes. Direct precondition for 08-04-audit-registry-snapshot-ast-removal. Consumer contract is _registry_from_snapshot (skill_review.py:248-309); a malformed snapshot raises ReviewError rather than falling back, so shipping a wrong snapshot is worse than shipping none.
